title: Nuclear polarization to the immune synapse facilitates an early transcriptional burst.
authors: Asano, Yukako; Ma, Claire Y; Limback-Stokin, Martin M; Rochussen, Adam M; Stinchcombe, Jane C; Griffiths, Gillian M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细胞毒性T淋巴细胞中细胞核极化与转录因子入核的时序关系，属细胞免疫学机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Target cell recognition by cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTLs) triggers rapid delivery of cytolytic granules to the immune synapse directed by the centrosome. Recent studies have also identified a rapid burst of T cell receptor (TCR)-activated transcription that contributes to CTL-mediated killing. To determine how de novo transcription might be coordinated with intracellular polarization, we asked when transcription factor translocation to the nucleus occurs relative to TCR activation and centrosome polarization within individual CTLs. Upon target cell recognition, the nucleus polarized to and contacted the immune synapse, preceding centrosome docking. The nucleus distorted as it moved, with transcription factors NFAT and NF-kappaB accumulating in the nucleus during polarization. Inhibition or deletion of myosin IIA prevented both nuclear polarization and transcription factor translocation. Thus, nuclear polarization facilitates an early transcriptional burst that occurs as CTLs encounter targets and the consequent delivery of newly synthesized cytokines to the immune synapse.
abstract_zh: 细胞毒性T淋巴细胞（CTLs）识别靶细胞触发快速递送细胞溶解颗粒至由中心体引导的免疫突触。近期研究还发现，T细胞受体（TCR）激活引发的快速转录爆发有助于CTL介导的杀伤作用。为确定新生转录如何与细胞内极化协调，我们探究了在单个CTL中，转录因子转位至细胞核相对于TCR激活和中心体极化的时间顺序。靶细胞识别后，细胞核极化并接触免疫突触，先于中心体对接。细胞核在移动过程中发生变形，转录因子NFAT和NF-kappaB在极化期间于核内积累。抑制或删除肌球蛋白IIA可阻止核极化和转录因子转位。因此，核极化促进了CTL遇到靶细胞时发生的早期转录爆发，以及随之而来的新合成细胞因子向免疫突触的递送。
